mission: Execute a granted inference request in an isolated worker without minting authority or mutating fleet state.
runtimeTopology: An isolated worker process consumes a current resource grant and exact model manifest. A ModelDriver owns runtime-specific load/run/unload; the worker enforces identity, resource and cancellation contracts.
physicalState: Worker state is ephemeral by design: generation, loaded model handles, active request handles and usage counters. Persistent model bytes belong to the artifact/cache owner and are verified read-only.
linearization: Load linearizes after manifest and grant validation and a driver-observed handle. Run linearizes at driver entry after request/reservation binding. Unload occurs only with zero active requests.
recovery: Load failure releases acquired resources; indeterminate driver results remain indeterminate; restart never mixes checkpoint/model/runtime generations.
security: Grant issuance and fleet mutation are denied. Exact weights, tokenizer, preprocessing, quantization, runtime, device, payload and resource grant are all bound before use.
capacity: Models <=8, active requests <=256, tokens <=1000000, memory <= explicit grant. Load/unload, peak/KV memory, token rate, p99 latency and cancellation are measured per target.
terminalObserver: The qualified ModelDriver observes model/runtime/device execution. The repository boundary cannot self-certify that real weights or a real accelerator executed.
externalEvidenceGaps: qualified real model driver with exact weights/runtime/device identity
authenticated control transport, OOM/device-reset and target-host measurements
